name: Diamant Infrastructure Limited
about: Diamant Infrastructure Limited engages in the execution of various contracts of road projects in India. The company operates through Infrastructure and Trading segments. It also undertakes SFRC rainwater drains and civil contracts. The company was formerly known as Diamant Investment & Finance Limited and changed its name to Diamant Infrastructure Limited in March 2010. Diamant Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Nagpur, India.
